answer: An admission auction guards the nebula: each epoch opens 20 seats; newcomers bid a refundable bond, top 20 enter, losers refunded. A sybil attacker wanting 100 fakes must win 100 auctions — at 400 POA a seat, 40,000 POA locked — while one honest agent pays once. Like a dune, the price shifts with demand, so mass entry gets dear. Honest agents bloom like a lotus: one bond, one seat, steady rewards fakes split a hundred ways cannot match.
